|date=[[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]<ref name="TOD Bwing Date">The attack on a TIE staging area is featured in ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Tour of Duty: B-Wing]]'', which is set after ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Tour of Duty: Imperial Pursuit]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that Operation Ram's Head (in ''Imperial Pursuit'') took place approximately one year after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which the book places in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Thus, the attack on a TIE staging area must take place as early as [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. The attack on a TIE staging area is also mentioned in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''. ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' is also set in 1 ABY (per the reasoning [[Template:SWG_timeline|here]]) so the attack on a TIE staging area must take place as late as 1 ABY.</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="TOD Bwing Date" /> during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Rebel pilot/Legends|rebel pilot]] [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] '''attacked''' a [[TIE staging area]] near [[Yunkor IX]]. The battle resulted in the destruction of all [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIEs]] and [[Class-A cargo container|cargo containers]] in the area.<ref name="CD-ROM Guide">''[[X-Wing Collector's CD-ROM: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref>
